mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT keep trending below baseline, weekday trip chaining into shops weakens and RETAIL_REC will stay lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below their current 4-week averages for the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A further drop in PARKS below its recent level signals substitution away from leisure outings, and within two weeks that reduced outing intensity will pull RETAIL_REC down rather than up.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days after PARKS crosses below -8 points week-on-week and stays there.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT improves by at least five points from its current depressed level while WORKPLACES remain near baseline, the added commuting flow should lift retail visits over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from the latest weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to its last-28-day mean after TRANSIT gains at least 5 points while WORKPLACES stay within 3 points of the current level.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent above-baseline RESIDENTIAL mobility combined with weak WORKPLACES suggests more local, non-shopping time at home, which suppresses discretionary retail movement over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays above +8 and WORKPLACES stays below -25 on weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS after a weak week indicates improving outdoor conditions and more footfall dispersion, which will lift retail-and-recreation activity within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 4 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve in the week after PARKS rises by at least 4 points from the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM remains stable or improves while TRANSIT stays depressed, households concentrate on essential trips and defer discretionary shopping, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays above -5 and TRANSIT stays below -30.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES recover from around -30 toward -20, the commuting base broadens enough to support more retail visits, but only after the change persists for a month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -25 and remains there for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 28-day average by week 4 after WORKPLACES moves above -25 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-residential, low-transit regime, additional declines in TRANSIT matter more than PARKS for retail demand; if both remain weak, RETAIL_REC will keep drifting down over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT stays below -30, RESIDENTIAL stays above +8, and PARKS stays below zero.
